About Lisbon

Lisbon tumbles over seven hills above the Tagus river — pastel facades, rattling trams, miradouro viewpoints and melancholic fado music.

Best time to visit Lisbon

The sweet spot is generally Mar–May & Sep–Oct — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Lisbon

  • Ride Tram 28 through Alfama
  • Tour Belem Tower and Jeronimos Monastery
  • Eat a warm pastel de nata
  • Catch sunset from a miradouro
  • Day-trip to fairytale Sintra

Good to know

Very safe. Language: Portuguese. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days.
